## Idea

Describe the idea in plain English.

## Problem / opportunity

What problem would this solve, or what opportunity does it create?

## Who is it for?

Who would benefit from it?

## Example

Describe how someone would use it.

## Notes

Anything else worth considering.

## Product review

- [ ] Clarify the user problem
- [ ] Consider race-day/mobile impact
- [ ] Check whether it fits the generic RaceSplit event model
- [ ] Decide: backlog / investigate / build / not now
